description: LIVE, c40 (Decisions only): the same 12 replies as browser-open-item-v1, asked with the c40 option wording (retry, ask_page and change narrowed, anchored to the open browser task; continue+retry overlap and retry+change overlap read as the weaker/more specific option). Pre-registered BEFORE any wording change, from the v1 measurement (sent 2026-11-25 19:08 from 9ca8185: 2 correct, 4 acceptable, 6 safe_miss, 0 wrong): the v1 predicates fired on things they were not about (ask_page 0.99 on "그만해", change 1.0 on "오늘 날씨 어때?", retry 0.88 on "했어"), so most replies were not settled. The wrong/acceptable/safe_miss verdicts are by code as in v1. Sent once.

passRule: No reply is WRONG (hard). Correct and safe-miss counts are reported; a safe miss never fails the plan. Stops at the first failed request, the request limit or the token ceiling. Replies that did not run count as not run.

preRegistrationNote: Written before the c40 wording change. The replies, wants and acceptable sets are v1's, unchanged, so the two runs compare reply by reply. The v1 predictions are kept under predictedV1Wording.
dropOrderNote: Fixed before any dry run, from the typed estimator (134.8 tokens per predicate + 0.198 per byte): one reply is a request of five predicates, about 1,010 estimated tokens, so 12 replies are about 12k, not 4k. Under a budget the replies are dropped in this order (first dropped first) until the estimate fits: at 4,000 the three that stay are again (the retry/continue overlap the c37 heads-up worried about), notyet (the unsafe error: continue settled on "아직") and ack (the baseline). --budget 13000 runs all twelve. Nothing is dropped silently: the run records what was dropped.
